_README.description: Model metadata for Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry-backed provider. The `models` definition can be copied from openrouter_models.json / custom_models.json
_README.usage: Models listed here are exposed through Azure AI Foundry. Aliases are case-insensitive.

field_descriptions.aliases: Array of short names users can type instead of the full model name
field_descriptions.context_window: Total number of tokens the model can process (input + output combined)
field_descriptions.max_output_tokens: Maximum number of tokens the model can generate in a single response (curated value). At read time it is lowered, never raised, to the figure LiteLLM publishes for the model if that is smaller (providers/shared/published_limits.py); a batch request is further bounded by OpenRouter's :batch listing.
field_descriptions.supports_extended_thinking: Whether the model supports extended reasoning (thinking). When true, thinking_mode is honoured where the provider implements it (native Gemini and Anthropic), the model is tagged 'thinking' in listmodels, and it is preferred for extended-reasoning auto-mode picks.
field_descriptions.supports_json_mode: Whether the model can guarantee valid JSON output
field_descriptions.supports_function_calling: Whether the model supports function/tool calling
field_descriptions.supports_images: Whether the model can process images/visual input
field_descriptions.max_image_size_mb: Maximum total size in MB for all images combined (capped at 40MB max for custom models)
field_descriptions.supports_temperature: Whether the model accepts temperature parameter in API calls (set to false for O3/O4 reasoning models)
field_descriptions.temperature_constraint: Type of temperature constraint: 'fixed' (fixed value), 'range' (continuous range), 'discrete' (specific values), or omit for default 0-2 range. A range (including the default) is narrowed, never widened, at read time to the vendor's documented range (Anthropic 0-1, OpenAI/Google/xAI 0-2); for Anthropic models LiteLLM supports_sampling_params=false forces fixed 1.0.
field_descriptions.use_openai_response_api: Set to true when the deployment must call Azure's /responses endpoint (O-series reasoning models). Leave false/omit for standard chat completions.
field_descriptions.default_reasoning_effort: Default reasoning effort level for models that support it (e.g., 'low', 'medium', 'high'). Omit if not applicable.
field_descriptions.intelligence_score: 1-20 human rating used as the primary signal for auto-mode model ordering
